regime_context: The detector shows a narrow rotation: 2 strongly-led themes (Banks, Innovative Pharma & CXO) that are both crowded, versus 3 ineligible/weakening trend names (AI Compute, Coal, Semiconductors). The absolute-trend gate has no drawdown-control edge in China A-shares (mean-reverting tape whipsaws it), and cross-sectional rank-IC is weak — this is a leadership concentration map, not alpha. Given gate_helps=false and a directional accuracy of 0.377 on 77 calls, conviction should be low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) overtakes Banks (512800.SS) as the leader for 5 consecutive sessions AND its breadth improves above 0.7 — that confirmed handoff would retire the current two-leader read; a re-widening of the Banks margin above 0.05 retires the Pharma challenging hypothesis.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks rank 1 with the highest durability (0.73) and broad participation (breadth 0.889) — the most cohesive leadership cluster. The trend-leg is mixed rather than clean trend, and crowding is high (1.78), so this is a continuation lean on the prevailing narrative rather than a fresh edge; size-down caution applies but not a fade.
evidence: durability_bar 0.73, the highest in the table
breadth 0.889 — broad participation, not a one-name story
crowding_z 1.78, crowded true — size-down only, not a sell
theses.dissent: The tape is documented as mean-reverting, the trend gate offered no drawdown protection here, and crowded high-momentum financial themes in A-shares have historically topped on attention spikes; the rank is a focus lens with rank-IC ~0.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by 4% before the check-by date and its breadth drops below 0.5

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the confirmed challenger, score 0.988 just 0.01 behind Banks with durability 0.60. It is also crowded (1.59) but eligible, and the rotation margin is thin — a leadership handoff is plausible but NOT yet confirmed, so this is a lean on the existing #2 trend rather than a handoff call.
evidence: challenger in rotation with margin 0.01 to leader
theses.dissent: Crowding in both leaders means the narrow narrative could unwind jointly in a mean-reversion snap; with breadth of rotation at only 0.18 the A-share tape shows no broad bid behind even the leaders.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags 512800.SS by 3% while CSI 300 rises, before the check-by date

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semis are eligible (trend gate allows) but rank 8 with weak score 0.315, durability 0.54, and extremely narrow breadth 0.091 — trend health is poor and participation is a single-name story. No participation leg supports a directional lean; avoid is the honest read.
evidence: hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.54 — mixed longevity signal
not crowded (crowding_z -0.15) so no reflexivity support either
theses.dissent: A single-name trend with strong momentum could break out if a policy or tech catalyst arrives, and avoiding an eligible name forfeits whatever trend continues.

falsifier.text: 512760.SS closes above its prior 20-day high with breadth above 0.3 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
